lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF, Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 25,200 shares for up to ₹3.41 crore, if all offered shares are sold.
Proceeds are up to ₹3.41 crore; gain is up to ₹2.52 crore before offer expenses and taxes. Employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago). Shares unlocked 66 days ago, on 9 Sep 2026, and are recent, not cash.
Retained stake is an estimate of ₹7.95 crore at offer price. Family link: unknown.
